text:
[Council File 25-0400-S2]
Housing Department report relative to authorizing the execution of a Memorandum of Understanding with the Housing Authority of the City of Los Angeles to implement a Social Housing Pilot program.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Yes
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: The Housing Department asks council to authorize a memorandum of understanding with the Housing Authority of the City of Los Angeles to run a Social Housing Pilot program.
